traps.quote: A time or membership fact supplied by the homeserver, or the absence of one, must not make an event visible to someone who could not see it.
traps.note: The evidence clause points at the fabricated-arrival lever beyond the plain reply route; no identifier, cached/fetched forms unnamed.

traps.quote: A time or membership fact supplied by the homeserver, or the absence of one
traps.note: Flags homeserver-supplied time as the lever, but not the fetched target, the far-future value or the bridge-clock bound.
Nothing about validating the fetched response's room identity or rejecting a missing room id; only the broad entitlement property covers it.
No mention of edits, replacements or diffs; only the general 'any text from a Matrix event' property reaches the removed words.
